topic.label: Knowledge
topic.desc: Knowledge management for people and agents: ontologies and taxonomies, knowledge graphs, entity resolution, metadata, curation and quality, retrieval and question answering, documentation and sharing. Extends the base Knowledge topic, which held only Knowledge Graph.

concepts.label: Curation and Quality
concepts.desc: Keeping a knowledge base correct: review queues, contradiction checks, staleness, deprecation and change history.

concepts.label: Knowledge Extraction
concepts.desc: Pulling entities, relations and claims out of documents, tables and conversations, with the source span for each.

concepts.label: Metadata and Provenance
concepts.desc: Describing knowledge with where it came from, when, under what licence and how much it can be trusted.

concepts.label: Ontology and Taxonomy Design
concepts.desc: Choosing the classes, relations and naming rules a body of knowledge uses, and keeping them consistent as they grow.

concepts.label: Graph Querying and Reasoning
concepts.desc: Asking questions of a graph: path and pattern queries, inference rules and checks for consistency.

concepts.label: Entity Resolution and Linking
concepts.desc: Deciding that two records are the same thing, merging them safely and linking mentions to canonical identifiers.

concepts.label: Retrieval and Question Answering
concepts.desc: Finding and using knowledge to answer questions: indexing, chunking, hybrid search, reranking and answers that cite their sources.

concepts.label: Documentation and Knowledge Sharing
concepts.desc: Turning what is known into pages people use: wikis, notes, glossaries, onboarding material and clear handoffs.

skills.label: Contradiction Finder
skills.desc: Finds statements in a knowledge base that cannot both be true and shows both sources side by side.

skills.label: Deprecation Planner
skills.desc: Plans how a fact or page is retired: redirect, replacement, notice and what depends on it.

skills.label: Review Queue Manager
skills.desc: Orders items for human review by risk and use, tracks decisions and reports review backlog.

skills.label: Claim Extractor
skills.desc: Lists the factual claims a document makes in separate sentences, each with its source location and whether it is checkable.

skills.label: Entity and Relation Extractor
skills.desc: Extracts entities and relations from text with the exact source sentence and a confidence for each.

skills.label: Table to Graph Mapper
skills.desc: Maps columns of a table to graph nodes and edges, with a mapping file and a sample of the resulting triples.

skills.label: Freshness Tracker
skills.desc: Records when each fact was last confirmed, sets a review interval by how fast it changes and lists items past due.

skills.label: Provenance Annotator
skills.desc: Adds source, date, author and licence to each item and reports items whose origin cannot be shown.

skills.label: Metadata Schema Designer
skills.desc: Designs a small required metadata schema, with controlled values and which fields are mandatory, and validates a sample.

skills.label: Naming Convention Writer
skills.desc: Writes identifier and label rules for concepts and tests them against existing names to find clashes.

skills.label: Ontology Modeler
skills.desc: Proposes classes, properties and relations for a domain from sample documents and lists the competency questions the model must answer.

skills.label: Taxonomy Builder
skills.desc: Builds a category tree with clear inclusion rules and checks that every item fits exactly one place or says why it fits several.

skills.label: Graph Consistency Checker
skills.desc: Runs constraint checks for missing required links, cycles and impossible values and lists violating nodes.

skills.label: Graph Query Writer
skills.desc: Writes a path or pattern query for a question about the graph and explains what each clause matches.

skills.label: Inference Rule Writer
skills.desc: Writes rules that derive new facts from existing ones and tests each rule for unwanted conclusions.

skills.label: Duplicate Record Finder
skills.desc: Finds likely duplicate records with similarity scores and shows the fields that agree and disagree.

skills.label: Identifier Linker
skills.desc: Links mentions to canonical identifiers in an external registry and flags ambiguous mentions for a person to decide.

skills.label: Safe Merge Planner
skills.desc: Plans a merge of two records, decides which field wins and records enough to undo the merge later.

skills.label: Chunking and Index Designer
skills.desc: Chooses how documents are split and indexed so passages keep their meaning, and measures retrieval on sample questions.

skills.label: Cited Answer Writer
skills.desc: Answers a question from retrieved passages, cites the passage behind each statement and says when the sources do not answer it.

skills.label: Hybrid Search Tuner
skills.desc: Tunes keyword and vector search weights and reranking against a labelled question set and reports the gain.

skills.label: Glossary Writer
skills.desc: Collects terms used across documents, writes one plain definition for each and flags terms used in conflicting senses.

skills.label: Handoff Note Writer
skills.desc: Writes a handoff note with current state, decisions made, open questions and where the supporting files are.

skills.label: Onboarding Guide Builder
skills.desc: Builds a reading path for a newcomer that orders pages by what they need first and marks the essential ones.

mcp.name: Evernote
mcp.desc: Connect Evernote to search, edit, and organize your notes, create new ones, and bring your knowledge into every conversation.

mcp.name: Wiley Scholar Gateway
mcp.desc: Enhance responses with scholarly research and citations

mcp.name: Memory (reference server)
mcp.desc: Reference MCP server: knowledge graph-based persistent memory system
